description: Hermes Kanban dispatcher resource policy for memory-constrained hosts. Codifies the 2026-10-16 remediation: VM with 7.7 GiB total RAM sits at ~83% baseline utilization, tripping the dispatcher's 15% MemAvailable pressure throttle and stalling all factory work.
operator_action: Copy the kanban block into ~/.hermes/config.yaml. No Hermes restart required — dispatch reads config per tick.
review_trigger: Revisit if VM memory increases, baseline utilization drops below 70%, or factory throughput becomes the bottleneck.
